summary: Hancock Whitney Corporation filed an 8-K announcing completion of its acquisition of OFB Bancshares, Inc., parent of One Florida Bank, effective August 1, 2026. The deal, announced May 15, 2026, closed with OFB Bancshares merging into a Hancock Whitney subsidiary and then into the parent, while One Florida Bank merged into Hancock Whitney Bank. Total cash consideration was approximately $377.6 million for common stock and stock options. Systems conversion is expected in Q4 2026. Watch for integration execution and potential cost savings as the transaction is now complete.
